author: Tfebles
title: Horrible
content:
Please, for the love of God, especially if addiction runs in your family, do NOT download these "win real money" gaming apps.
They're gambling. That's all they are.
I downloaded one thinking I could make a little extra money to help cover rent after paying bills. Instead, I became addicted. At first, they make it seem like you're winning. They give you just enough success to keep you coming back. Then when you start losing, all you can think about is winning back what you've already spent.
Before you know it, you're broke, borrowing money, hiding how much you've lost, and chasing a win that never comes.
Since March, I've lost over $15,000. I'm now attending GA meetings, and I'm struggling to pay my rent because of this addiction.
What makes these apps especially dangerous is that they're on your phone. It takes seconds to hit Apple Pay and deposit more money without realizing how much you're spending.
If you're young, struggling financially, lonely, stressed, or have a family history of addiction, please don't start. It is not worth it.
And to influencers promoting these apps: you may see them as sponsorships, but there are real people whose lives are being damaged by what you're advertising. Gambling addiction is devastating, and it's becoming a growing problem for younger generations.
People end their lives over this 
Please learn from my mistake instead of making it yourself.
